To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

La-doped SrM-type hexaferrite exhibits excellent microwave absorption properties with a minimum RL peak in a −10-dBandwidth of 3.43, 2.63, 3.92 and 2.30 GHz in the K-band for y = 10, 15, 20 and 25, respectively.
La-doped strontial ferrites exhibit high absorption in the microwave range.
the lanthanum-doping in M-type strontium hexagonal ferrites has a positive effect on the electromagnetic wave absorption properties of ferrites in the K and Ka-bands.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the microwave absorption properties of La-doped strontum M-type hexaferrite in a 10–18 GHz frequency range.
the microwave absorption properties of lanthanum-doping strontium hexagonal ferrite in the K- and Ka-bands.
the design, synthesis and electromagnetic characterization of La-doped strontial ferrite in the microwave frequency range.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the La-doped strontia hexaferrite is an efficient microwave absorber in a 18 to 40 GHz frequency range and the absorption bandwidth can be further increased by increasing La concentration.
La-doped strontia ferrite is a promising candidate for microwave absorption applications in the K- and Ka-bands.
the La-doped M-type strontium hexa ferrites have the potential to be used for the design and fabrication of efficient and lightweight microwave absorbers in a wide frequency range.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the ferrite compositions with y = (0.10,0.20 and0.25) have a better microwave absorption performance than the composition with y =0.15 in the 18–40GHz frequency range.
the La3+-substituted SrFe12O19 ferrite is a good microwave absorber in the 18–40-GHz range.
the ferrites are promising candidates as efficient microwave absorber materials in the K- and Ka-band.
The main takeaway from our work is that
lanthanum doping in M-type hexagonal strontium ferrite can enhance microwave absorption in the X-band (8–12 GHz), K-band (18–26 GHz) and Ka-band (26–40 GHz) frequency ranges.
the La doping of M-type hexagonal ferrite can improve its microwave absorption properties in a wide range of frequencies.
the RL peak and the absorption bandwidth can be tailored by varying the La3+ ion concentration.
